# BidLab

> Local-first assistant that turns a Spanish public-tender PDF into an
> eligibility check and a defensible bid price. Meta's Muse Spark reads the
> tender (text + page image, strict JSON Schema) and drafts clarification
> questions; muse-voice-transcribe and Muse Spark tool calling answer spoken
> questions through BidLab's own deterministic Python engine. A person
> approves every extracted rule; price, points and the abnormal-offer rule
> are computed in Decimal Python, never by the model. UI designed for older
> users (16 px floor, AAA contrast, 48 px targets, voice).

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): product, Meta usage, architecture, run and verify
- [docs/META_EVIDENCE.md](docs/META_EVIDENCE.md): live Muse Spark evaluation, 12/12 adversarial cases, receipts and spend
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): implemented stack and component limits
- [docs/RULE_ENGINE.md](docs/RULE_ENGINE.md): price/points math and review states
- [docs/REVIEWER_GUIDE.md](docs/REVIEWER_GUIDE.md): claims mapped to code and tests
- [docs/demo/README.md](docs/demo/README.md): screenshots

## Code with the main design decisions

- apps/api/bidlab/services/meta_adapter.py: live vs offline gate, bounded hybrid packet, receipts
- apps/api/bidlab/services/clarification.py: Muse Spark drafts wording bound to one citation
- apps/api/bidlab/services/assistant.py: voice + tool calling over the engine
- apps/api/bidlab/domain/: pure Decimal engine and whitelisted formula AST
- apps/web/src/styles.css: accessibility design rules (top comment)
- apps/web/src/features/requirements/ClarificationPanel.tsx: consent and honest states

## Run

`uv sync --all-packages && npm install && npm run build && python scripts/demo.py --reset-demo`,
then http://127.0.0.1:8000/. Offline demo needs no key; live Meta features need
BIDLAB_MODE=live, MODEL_API_KEY and META_API_URL. Gates: `python scripts/verify.py`.
